evidence.title: Payment evidence queue
evidence.ownRecord: You recorded this; another platform admin must verify it.
evidence.description: Client payments, refunds and remittances recorded by organizations. A second person must verify each one.
evidence.emptyHint: New evidence shows up here as soon as it's recorded.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Disagreements about a placement, its payment, or a contested prior-presentation objection. Each card says what resolving it changes.
disputes.emptyHint: Organizations open disputes from a placement's page, or by contesting a prior-presentation objection.

claim.priorDate: Candidate last in process with this client: {date}
claim.samePersonError: The contact details couldn't be compared. Try again.
claim.flagReleased: Candidate released by the sourcing side

rules.title: Commission rules
rules.description: The default split for new collaboration agreements. Each change publishes a new version.
rules.snapshotNote: Accepted referrals keep the split that was in force when they were accepted.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.name: Name
orgs.description: Every organization on MissionHub: members, region and access status.
orgs.search: Search by name or workspace URL

suspension.reinstateDescription: Members regain access. Matching resumes on the next change.
suspension.suspendDescription: Members immediately lose access. Its jobs and candidates stop matching; existing referrals and finance records are preserved and remain visible to partners; partners can't submit to its jobs.

dispute.resolveDescription: The placement returns to its prior status. Record any corrections as correcting entries.
dispute.rejectDescription: The placement returns to its prior status.
dispute.upholdDescription: The objection is valid. The decline stands, and this referral no longer holds first position for this client. Its ownership date doesn't change.
dispute.rejectClaimDescription: The objection isn't valid. The referral goes back to {target} for review, and they can't file another objection on it. It keeps first position, and its ownership date doesn't change.
dispute.resolutionVisible: Both organizations read this resolution. Don't include client names or details from the evidence files.
dispute.languageHint: Languages: {source} · {sourceLanguage}, {target} · {targetLanguage}. Write in French or bilingually for organizations in Québec.

validation.resolution: Write a resolution of 5 to 2,000 characters.
validation.resolutionLong: Write a resolution of 20 to 2,000 characters.

messages.rulePublished: New rule version published. Existing agreements keep the split they were created with.
messages.claimUpheld: Objection upheld. Both organizations were notified.
messages.claimRejected: Objection rejected. The referral is back in review, and both organizations were notified.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Platform health at a glance. Admins never see candidate records, only aggregates.
overview.privacyNote: Counts only. Candidate details stay with their organization.

orgDetail.liftHoldDescription: Its jobs become visible to partners again, and it can submit and receive referrals. Its admins are notified.
orgDetail.liftSuspensionDescription: Settlement mode ends, and members get full access again. Its admins are notified.
orgDetail.liftTerminationDescription: Use this only to correct an error found after the decision. Settlement mode ends, members get full access again, and the termination won't count in later decisions. Its admins are notified.
orgDetail.liftTerminationReason: What was the error? (kept in the audit log)
orgDetail.liftTerminationSelf: You decided this termination, so another platform admin must lift it.
orgDetail.obligationsHint: Settlement mode ends when this list is empty.
orgDetail.allSettled: All settled. Members no longer have access.
orgDetail.closeStaleDescription: Both sides will see it as cancelled. The sourcing side keeps its ownership window.
orgDetail.closeStaleReason: Reason (kept in the audit log, admins only)

errors.notStale: This referral had activity in the last 60 days, so it can't be closed this way.
errors.notTerminated: Only referrals of an organization removed from the network can be closed this way.
errors.liftNotAllowed: Another platform admin must lift this termination.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone with an account, the organizations they belong to and their role in each.
users.name: Name

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sensitive action across the platform, newest first.
audit.search: Filter by action, e.g. referral. or organization.suspended

flags.title: Organizations to review
flags.note: Flags are signals for review. Nothing happens automatically.

referralTerms.title: Referral terms
referralTerms.description: Find a referral to see its terms, or record an amendment both organizations asked for in writing.
referralTerms.lookupHint: Paste the referral link from the organizations' written request.
referralTerms.notFound: No referral matches this link or ID. Check it and try again.
referralTerms.historyRequests: Written requests: hiring organization “{hiring}” · sourcing organization “{sourcing}”
referralTerms.amendDescription: Only when both organizations asked in writing, before a hire is recorded. The original terms stay visible to both.
referralTerms.attestationCarried: The hiring organization's direct-client statement carries over from the original terms.
referralTerms.windowLocked: This referral was delivered on {date}. The ownership window can't change after delivery.
referralTerms.reasonHint: Only platform admins see this. 10 to 1,000 characters. Don't include candidate names or contact details.
referralTerms.requestHint: Where to find it, e.g. email of Nov 14 from the organization admin. 3 to 200 characters.
referralTerms.bothAsked: Both organizations asked for this change in writing.

validation.reasonLength: Enter a reason of 10 to 1,000 characters
validation.requestLength: Enter a reference of 3 to 200 characters
validation.bothAskedRequired: Confirm both organizations asked in writing

referralTerms.amendConfirmDescription: Both organizations are notified, and the original terms stay visible. You can't undo this, but you can record another amendment before a hire is recorded.

messages.recorded: Amendment recorded. Both organizations were notified.

referralTerms.blockedHired: A hire was recorded on {date}. Terms can't be amended after a hire. Fee differences are handled with the invoiced fee and its reason, or in a placement dispute.
referralTerms.blockedLegacy: This referral was sent before the terms card. There are no recorded terms to amend.

termsMetrics.title: Terms for partners
termsMetrics.hiddenJobs: Referral-open jobs hidden for missing terms

hireRecord.title: Hire record
hireRecord.noteHint: Only platform admins see this. For example: “Hired by a related organization of {org} (shared member).”

hireReports.title: Hire reports
hireReports.description: Contested and unanswered hire reports, authorization checks and overdue duties. You decide whether a hire counts, never the amount.

empty.all: No hire reports, checks or tasks right now.

hireReports.jobClientToday: Client name on the job today: {client}

coverage.title: Coverage test (you apply it)
coverage.one: The referral was in progress when the offer was made.
coverage.two: The offer was accepted inside the window (start date if the acceptance date is unknown).
coverage.three: The selection process started inside the window, and the offer was accepted within 3 months after it ended.
coverage.never: Never a defence inside the protection: “we found them ourselves”, “they applied directly”, “through another agency”, “a different role”, “the referral was declined or withdrawn”.

hireReports.noDeliveryRecords: No email delivery records (emails start with N7).
hireReports.candidateContactedHint: At most one contact is expected.
hireReports.upholdBodyPlacement: The hire counts on this referral. A placement is created with fee details pending from {org}, due in 10 business days. Both organizations are notified.
hireReports.upholdBodyNoSplit: The hire counts, but this referral has no confirmed agreement, so it's recorded without a split. Both organizations are notified.
hireReports.findingHint: For “Not this client”, the sourcing side sees only “Not this client”, not your resolution.
hireReports.resolutionHint: Both organizations read it. Don't name the client.

task.feeOverdue: Rule 6.4 notice due: fee details overdue since {date}

detail.legacy: Terms not recorded (sent before the terms card): {value}
detail.decided: Decision saved. Both organizations were notified.

networkRules.title: Network Rules versions
networkRules.description: Publish versions of the rules members accept. Published versions can't be changed or deleted.
networkRules.upcomingExists: A version is already scheduled. You can publish another after it takes effect.
networkRules.emptyDescription: Members can't join or use the network until a version is published.
networkRules.label: Version label
networkRules.typeHint: When in doubt, publish as a material change.

typeDescription.initial: The first version. Takes effect when you publish.
typeDescription.material: Members must accept it. It takes effect 30 days or more after publication.
typeDescription.non_material: Wording or clarity only. Takes effect when you publish. No acceptance needed.
typeDescription.legally_required: A law requires the change. It can take effect sooner. Members must accept it.

networkRules.effectiveMin: Earliest date for a material change: {date}
networkRules.legalReasonHint: Members see this with the change summary.
networkRules.summaryHint: What changed, in plain words. Members read this before accepting.
networkRules.textHint: Paste the publish-ready Markdown for this language.
networkRules.approvalHint: Who approved this text and when, e.g. Founder and counsel approval, Dec 1, 2026.
networkRules.deleteDraftDescription: The draft is deleted for good. Published versions aren't affected.
networkRules.publishMaterial: Members are notified now and must accept by {date}. Published versions can't be changed or deleted.
networkRules.publishLegal: Members are notified now and must accept by {date}. They see the legal reason with the change summary. Published versions can't be changed or deleted.
networkRules.publishNow: It takes effect now, and members are notified. No acceptance is needed. Published versions can't be changed or deleted.
networkRules.publishInitial: It takes effect now. Every member must accept it before using the network. Published versions can't be changed or deleted.

errors.marker: Remove the review markers from the {locale} text.
errors.effective: A material change can take effect on {date} at the earliest.
errors.effectivePast: Choose today or a later date.
errors.labelTaken: This label is already used. Choose another.
errors.legalReason: Write a legal reason of {min} to {max} characters.
errors.approval: Enter who approved this text and when ({min} to {max} characters).

badFaith.one: {org}: {count} report in the last 12 months found no breach.
badFaith.other: {org}: {count} reports in the last 12 months found no breach.

conduct.languageHint: {org} works in {language}. Write the notice in French, or bilingually, for organizations in Québec.

case.title: Conduct case · {org}
case.historyEmpty: No warnings, sanctions or open cases.

conduct.adminCategoryHint: Required before the first response. Metrics use this category. The reporter never sees it.
conduct.askHint: Only the reporter sees this. {org} doesn't.
conduct.closeTitle: Close this case without a finding?
conduct.closeDescription: No notice is sent to {org}. The reporter sees “Closed without a finding” and your message.

closeReasonOption.amount: Amount owed: placement dispute or rule 7.5

conduct.closed: Case closed. The reporter was notified.

notice.title: Notice to {org}
notice.conductDateHint: Prefilled from the report. It sets which rules version applies.
notice.conductDateBeforeRules: No Network Rules were in force on this date. Choose {date} or later.
notice.rulesVersionHint: Defaults to the version in force on the date of the conduct. One version per notice.
notice.rulesHint: Only rules from the chosen version. The decision can cite only these rules.
notice.evidenceHint: Summarize the evidence. Don't paste the report or name the reporter. Keep candidate and client details to what they need to respond (rule 8.4).
notice.nameReporterHint: Only if they need it to respond fairly.
notice.deadline: Response deadline: {when} ET (10 business days after sending)
notice.previewHint: This is exactly what {org}'s admins will see.
notice.confirmDescription: You can't edit it after sending. Their 10 business days to respond start now.

conduct.decideLocked: You can decide once {org} responds or the window closes on {when} ET.

decision.title: Decision
decision.rulesFromNotice: Only rules cited in the notice. To rely on another rule, send a new notice.
decision.findingHint: {org} will read this. State the facts and how they break the rules cited.
decision.residualHint: Tick if no specific rule covered this case. {org} will see that rule 7.4 was used.

sanctionDescription.none: First minor breach only. The finding is recorded.
sanctionDescription.warning: Counts for 12 months. No other effect.
sanctionDescription.network_hold: No new partner activity. Referrals in progress continue. Lasts until lifted.
sanctionDescription.suspension: Settlement mode: only referrals in progress and what's owed. Lasts until lifted.
sanctionDescription.termination: Removed from the network. Settlement mode until everything is settled. Can reapply after 12 months.

decision.noneDisabled: Not available: {org} has a sanction or a breach finding in the last 12 months that wasn't overturned.
decision.plannedReviewHint: For planning only. The hold doesn't end on this date.
decision.whyNotHold: Why isn't a network hold enough?
decision.terminationNote: They can reapply after 12 months (rule 9.7). Settlement mode lasts until their referrals and placements are settled.
decision.sameNotice: Use this only if the facts and rules are the ones in the notice. New facts or rules need a new notice.
decision.noStakesLine: This notice didn't list every possible outcome. Send a new notice to decide a higher level.
decision.context: Active warnings and sanctions in the last 12 months

confirm.noSanction: No sanction applies. {org}'s admins are notified and can read the decision.
confirm.none: The finding is recorded on {org}'s file, with no sanction. Its admins are notified.
confirm.warning: {org} gets a warning that counts for 12 months. Its admins are notified.
confirm.hold: {org} will be on a network hold from now on. Its jobs will be hidden from partners. Referrals in progress continue.
confirm.holdKeep: {org}'s network hold continues until it's lifted.
confirm.holdLift: {org}'s network hold ends now. Its jobs become visible to partners again.
confirm.suspension: {org} will be suspended from now on and enter settlement mode. Members can only finish referrals in progress and settle what's owed.
confirm.termination: {org} will be removed from the network now and enter settlement mode until everything is settled. It can reapply after 12 months.

hold.title: Apply an immediate network hold
hold.ground23: Rule 2.3: shared information outside their organization
hold.ground48: Rule 4.8: forged evidence or false candidate confirmations
hold.groundHint: Only these two grounds allow a hold before the organization responds.
hold.confirmTitle: Apply the hold and send the notice now?
hold.confirmDescription: {org}'s jobs will be hidden from partners right away. Their referrals in progress continue. Their 10 business days to respond start now.

review.title: Review
review.selfBlocked: You decided this, so another platform admin must review it.
review.selfBlockedHold: You applied this hold, so another platform admin must review it.
review.needsSecond: Needs a second admin. No other platform admin can review this yet.
review.overturnHint: The sanction is lifted and won't count in later decisions.

incident.title: Send a data incident notice
incident.intro: Tell affected organizations what happened to their information. Write facts only. Don't mention the decision, the sanction or the reporter.
incident.orgsEmpty: Add a referral to find affected organizations.

confirm.one: Send this incident notice to {count} organization? It doesn't mention any sanction.
confirm.other: Send this incident notice to {count} organizations? It doesn't mention any sanction.

conduct.newCaseDescriptionHint: Only platform admins see this. The organization sees only the notice you send.

errors.alreadyRestricted: {org} is already on a network hold, suspended or removed from the network. An immediate hold isn't possible.
errors.noSanctionNotAllowed: “No sanction” isn't allowed: {org} has a sanction or a breach finding in the last 12 months that wasn't overturned. Choose a level.
errors.reasonRequired: Explain why a network hold isn't enough.
errors.groundInvalid: An immediate hold is allowed only under rule 2.3 or 4.8.
errors.cannotIncrease: A review can't increase the sanction. To go higher, send a new notice.

authCheck.invalidBody: The referral stops counting and loses first position. No fee is owed on it. The consent is marked disputed, and the case is flagged for breach review. A pending hire report closes. You can't undo this.
authCheck.candidateContacted: I contacted the candidate through contact details the sourcing recruiter didn't provide
authCheck.chooseRequester: Choose who asked for the check
